description: Source code implementing optimization passes for folding frozen convolution operations with batch normalization, addition/subtraction, multiplication/division in PyTorch's JIT compiler.

methods.name: supportedConvNode
methods.description: Checks if a node represents a supported convolution operation (conv1d, conv2d, conv3d, or convolution).

methods.name: FoldFrozenConvBatchnorm
methods.description: Performs folding of batch normalization into convolution for frozen graphs.

methods.name: supportedAddOrSub
methods.description: Checks if a node is an addition or subtraction operation.

methods.name: opDoesNotBroadCastWithConv
methods.description: Checks if an operation tensor does not broadcast with convolution weight tensor.

methods.name: checkConvAndBroadcastingOpPreConditions
methods.description: Verifies preconditions for broadcasting operations with convolution.

methods.name: resizeConstantScalarOrTensorToShape
methods.description: Resizes or expands a scalar or tensor value to a specified shape.

methods.name: FoldFrozenConvAddOrSub
methods.description: Folds add/sub operations into convolution for frozen graphs.

methods.name: supportedMulOrDiv
methods.description: Checks if a node is a multiplication or division operation.

methods.name: FoldFrozenConvMulOrDiv
methods.description: Folds mul/div operations into convolution for frozen graphs.
